summary.headline: Occultations of Saturn and Jupiter
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Saturn’s occultation through Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, and Pisces, followed by general judgments for Jupiter’s occultation and its effects on religion, weather, disease, and mortality.
